title: Push.io
description: Push.io is a fast-paced arena game where you battle to stay on the map and push everyone else off. Wield your boomerang with precision to knock rivals into the water while dodging incoming attacks. The longer you survive, the higher you rank; fall early, and you’ll drop in the standings. Earn trophies, upgrade your boomerang between rounds, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate arena champion.

title: Dark Myth: Monkey Merge
description: Merge warriors, build your army, and fight through hordes of monsters as the Monkey King! Your master and companions have been captured — combine strategy and action to rescue them all. From Common to Legendary, every merge makes you stronger.

title: House Robber
description: House Robber is a free online game with the theme of a robber for boys. In the game, you will play a robber, sneak into the house and steal all kinds of goods. Be careful to return after you get it, and don't be found by the security guard. Each level has its own scene, so you must be careful in stealing. The whole process is very exciting, are you confident to surpass it? Come and challenge!

title: Sudoku - Pin.Games
description:
Sudoku - PIN.GAMES is a polished, feature-rich take on the timeless number puzzle. Fill the 9×9 grid so that every row, column, and 3×3 block contains the digits 1–9 exactly once.

With six difficulty levels, smart hints, combo scoring, daily challenges, and five handcrafted visual themes, it offers a clean, relaxing, and logic-focused Sudoku experience for both casual players and puzzle lovers.

title: Candy Color Sort Puzzle
description: Welcome to our addictive and fun ball sort color puzzle game! If you're looking for a game that challenges your brain and keeps you entertained for hours, you've come to the right place. You'll never get bored. Our game is perfect for those who enjoy brain teasers, puzzles, and games that challenge their cognitive skills.

title: Jigsaw M
description: the jigsaw game includes dozens of different puzzles. you can increase or decrease the number of pieces of these puzzles as you wish. so you can make it suitable for all ages. you can have a pleasant time by having fun and exercising your brain. come on we are waiting for you.

title: Paper Doll Diary: Dress Up DIY
description: ? Welcome to Paper Doll Diary: Doll DressUp, where the timeless charm of DIY paper dolls meets the exhilarating world of fashion dress up! Step into a realm of creativity and style where you become the master stylist of your enchanting paper doll dress up. With an expansive wardrobe featuring over 1000 fashion items, including the latest in trendy attire, distinctive accessories, diverse hairstyles, and soothing ASMR makeup touches, your creative potential is limitless.

title: Arrow Escape
description: Get ready for a fast-paced and strategic arrow challenge in Arrow Escape, an addictive arrows puzzle escape game built for players who love logic puzzles and intense puzzle escape moments.

title: Farm Blast
description: Farm Blast is a colorful level-based blast puzzle game set on a vibrant farm. Complete exciting objectives, overcome tricky obstacles, and unlock powerful boosters as you progress through hundreds of engaging levels. With bright visuals, satisfying chain reactions, and strategic gameplay, this addictive casual puzzle game is perfect for fans of match-3 games, farm games, and relaxing yet challenging brain teasers.

title: Gummy merge
description: Jelly merge is an endless game in which to merge identical marmalades. The goal of the game is to reach the final marmalade.

title: Mermaid Wedding World
description: Mermaid Wedding World is a creative dress-up and decorating game for girls. The princess of the ocean kingdom is getting married to a human and they are going to have a wedding now. You can help prepare the food, set the table, serve the people, and play music. You may help the bride, groom,and other guests to dress up and makeup. You may also decorate the room to your liking.

title: Type Sprint
description: Are you good at typing on the keyboard or mobile? Type Sprint is both a running racing game and a typing relaxation game with 3D stickman players. It is managed for you to type fast to make platforms for your character to run forward as the first three. I think typing on PC is easier than it on mobile. Good luck and have fun!

title: Blade Forge 3D
description: Step into the fiery forge of Blade Forge 3D, the ultimate 3D simulation casual game. You become the legendary blacksmith. Craft epic weapons from scratch. After matching opponents, choose your own mold and craft your own sword. Temper the sword by forging the blade between the flames. Once completed, the sword will be used to test itself against your opponent. Serious polishing to boost your damage value.

title: Ludo World
description: Experience endless fun with various vibrant environments, where every roll of the dice brings a new challenge. Choose between classic or quick mode, progress along the trophy road, and prove you're the master of the board with every move you make.

title: Stick Rope Hero
description: Are you ready to become a super stickman hero? In Stick Rope Hero, you enter an exciting sandbox world filled with adventures and challenges. Swing around the open city with your powerful rope skills and completing many action tasks.

title: Wood Blocks Jam
description:
Wood Blocks Jam is a relaxing logic puzzle game with colorful wooden blocks. Your goal is to drag each block into a gate of the same color. No time limits — just calm, thoughtful gameplay.

Enjoy thousands of handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty and new mechanics to discover.

title: Agent Hunt: Spy Shooter Game
description: Step into the role of an elite hitman in this tactical first-person shooter. Complete covert missions with precision shooting, stealth infiltration, and strategic planning. Use advanced sniper weapons to eliminate targets across diverse environments from cities to enemy hideouts in this action-packed spy thriller.

title: Packing Line
description: Ship all the cans. Choose a box of the same color as the can. The game is over if you run out of space for boxes and the line stops.

title: Ship Parking Game
description: Solve colorful passenger seating puzzles on ships in this unique traffic jam puzzle game. Help passengers find their seats based on color patterns while managing the flow of people through parking lot-style challenges. It's not just about parking - you're a traffic director managing passenger jams on the high seas.

title: Warping Bat
description: In Warping Bat you have to bounce from spring to spring in order to collect all of the coins in the level which will then open the exit gate. Face more than twenty levels, avoiding obstacles, and bouncing around each level! Try your best and see if you have what it takes to complete the game in its entirety!

title: Scary Pairs
description: In the new exciting online game Scary Pairs you will have fun going through the levels of an interesting puzzle that is dedicated to Halloween. In front of you on the screen you will see a playing field on which a certain number of cards will be located. They lie face down and in one move you can turn over any two cards. Look at the images on them, because after a while the cards will return to their original state and you will make your move again.

title: Football Penalty
description: Step into an exhilarating, never-ending penalty challenge! Show your opponents the power of your accurate shots and become a real football hero. Collect points for every target hit, progress through levels, and improve your football skills. Take part in a big tournament and get more rewards.

title: Diep.io
description: Diep.io is a survival .io game where you control a circle armed with a cannon. The aim is simple: move around the map and destroy the other players whilst improving and upgrading your own circle.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Kawaii Realm Adventure
description: Embark on a whimsical journey to the "Kawaii Realm" with Sarah, Emma, Lily, and Mia! Discover a hidden portal in their school basement, transforming them into adorable 2D characters. Engage in dress-up and makeup activities for a delightful adventure!

title: Build and Run
description: Experience the ultimate blend of running and building in our action-packed game! Navigate through exciting levels by constructing missing parts of the level while running at full speed. Master using horizontal builds, slopes, and ramps to keep moving forward and avoid dangerous traps.

title: Cinema Empire Idle Tycoon
description: Welcome to Cinema Empire Idle Tycoon! Do you dream of owning your own movie theater empire? Now's your chance! In this super fun idle simulation management game, you'll start with a small screening room! Build your own cinema empire! As a theater owner, you need to manage every aspect of the theater. Unlock the theater's facilities, ticket booths, movie halls, dining areas, and more. Hiring employees to help you get more bang for your buck.

title: Murder Case Clue 3D
description: Murder Case Clue 3D is an exciting 3d escape game. You will play the role of detective, there was a murder recently, you need to find some clues and escape from this dangerous house. Be careful, good luck!

title: Cake Sort
description:
Cake Sort is a colorful and cozy puzzle game where you stack and sort delicious desserts to score as many points as possible! Move cakes around the table and match them by type to build perfect stacks of identical treats.
Bright graphics, smooth animations, and tasty visuals make the game relaxing, cheerful, and endlessly replayable.
Your goal is simple — keep sorting cakes and earn points for every perfect match until the table is full!

title: Jewel Legend Quest
description: The most legendary quest of your life begins! Miners from all around the world have come to get their hands on these precious gems. Join them in the effort and engage in various challenges while trying to dig out as many diamonds as possible.

title: Wonders of Egypt Match 2
description: Wonders of Egypt Match 2 returns with a brand-new Match-3 adventure in Ancient Egypt! Travel with your loyal Sphinx through pyramids, temples, palaces, and towering obelisks. Match 3+ sparkling gems to uncover treasures, artifacts, and hidden secrets. Conquer hundreds of fresh levels, complete tricky goals, and use powerful boosters when you need a helping hand. Earn dazzling rewards and prove your skills as the mysteries of the desert unfold in every chapter! Ready to play? Step in and match!

title: Pipe Puzzle: Connect & Flow
description:
Pipe Puzzle: Connect & Flow – Relaxing Brain Teaser
Connect the pipes, let the water flow, and solve hundreds of satisfying puzzles!
Pipe Puzzle: Connect & Flow is a relaxing and addictive puzzle game where your mission is simple: fix the pipes and restore the flow of water. Perfect for all ages, it's the ultimate brain exercise you can play anytime, anywhere.

title: 2 Cars Run
description: 2 Cars Run is a dual racing game where you need to control the vehicle to avoid all obstacles. The difficulty of this game is that you have to control one car while taking care of the other. Well, are you ready to challenge this game now? Come on!

title: Zombie Conquer Countries
description: In Zombie Conquer Countries, you’ll start with just a handful of infected zombies and gradually sweep through cities, expanding your territory until the entire map becomes your domain. Every successful infection will rapidly grow your army, creating an unstoppable rush of expansion! The game combines expansion mechanics with satisfying progression, creating an addictive experience for fans of zombie games.

title: Ninja Obby Parkour
description:
Step into the thrilling world of Ninja Obby Parkour, where every level is a test of speed, agility, and strategy. Packed with hundreds of unique obstacle courses, this game combines competitive racing with ninja-style combat and dazzling customization options.

From smashing glass doors at checkpoints with your ninja power to unlocking powerful bonuses like speed boost, giant mode, and flight, every run feels fresh.

title: Merge Fruit
description: Looking for something fun, relaxing, and totally addictive? You just found it. Merge Fruit is a simple but surprisingly strategic puzzle game where you combine fruits to create even bigger ones. It’s a satisfying blend of logic, timing, and casual fun that’s perfect for any moment.

title: Stickman Rocket
description: You have a powerful cannon loaded with Stickman Ragdols which you must shoot far to reach your target! Solve all kinds of challenges as you collect gems, avoid obstacles and control your throws to reach the targets in each level. Try not to bump into obstacles along the way and use all the raggedy characters you need to have fun with these amazing challenges - good luck!

title: Gun Clone
description:
A free browser game Gun Clone in the arcade and runner genre about cloning guns. Upgrade your weapons, collect cards. The game for girls and boys. The game is endless and pay attention, the levels are simple, but there are also very difficult ones! 
Take weapons and destroy everything in your path! By collecting various bonuses, more and more destructive weapons appear in your hands.

title: Candy Riddles
description: Candy Riddles is a puzzle match-3 puzzle game bursting with tasty-looking, mouth-watering sweets! Prepare for a world of sugary fun as you match cookies, donuts, ice creams, and more to rack up points and progress through challenging levels.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Magic Sort
description:
Welcome to Magic Sort! — a relaxing and satisfying color-sorting puzzle with a cute cat café twist!
Your job is to organize colorful water layers inside multiple bottles. Each bottle contains mixed colors, and you must pour them carefully to sort every color correctly. Remember:
You can only pour when the top layers are the same color.
Once a bottle is perfectly sorted and filled with a single color, it magically transforms into a finished drink for your adorable cat customers!

title: TimeWarriors
description:
Lead your army to glory through the ages! Embark on an epic journey through history. From primitive battles of the Stone Age to the futuristic wars of the future — become the greatest commander the world has ever known.

Become a great commander and lead your army to victory! Play “Time Warriors” now!

title: Offline FPS Royale
description:
Embark on a perilous journey in Offline FPS Royale, a brand new 3D shooter where you must fight for your life by eliminating every person you come across. You will get closer to finishing the map with every person you remove.

Kill foes from every angle in battle royale games as a stealthy assassin with the most captivating sniper experience.

title: Perfect Shot
description:
Step into Perfect Pocket, a unique puzzle game inspired by classic pool, but with a twist – you only get one shot to clear each level! Test your aim, plan your angles, and pocket all balls in a single move. 
Game Highlights :- 
One-Shot Levels: Every level challenges you to pocket all balls with just one shot. 
Realistic Physics: Feel the true motion and collision of balls. Many Unique Levels: Each with different layouts and increasing difficulty.

title: Tow N Go
description: Tow N Go is a thrilling game where you hit the road and become the coolest truck driver. Your mission is to tow cars parked in "No parking" areas and collect as many as you can at once. But beware! It's not an easy job. Avoid crashing into trains or other cars on the road. The more cars you collect, the richer you become. Challenge yourself in this exciting towing adventure and make loads of money today!

title: Idle Bathroom Empire Tycoon
description: Ready to become the ultimate bathroom tycoon? In this exciting mix of simulation, management, and idle tycoon gameplay, you’ll start with a small restroom. Grow it into a luxurious five-star hygiene haven! Upgrade facilities, optimize services, and expand your empire to make your bathroom the most popular spot in town. Manage your front desk with care, and faster cashiering will give you more cash flow.

title: Shopaholic Black Friday
description: Experience fashion fun like never before with the Shopaholic Black Friday game! Navigate through makeup products, and indulge in chic fashion pieces. Hit the mall, shop as many items as you can before the time runs out, and then return for another styling adventure. Explore an array of lipstick hues, experiment with smoky eyes, or go for colorful shadows, and browse through fashionable dresses, trendy tops, and stylish shoes. Complete the look with dazzling accessories and designer bags.

title: Italian Brainrot Bike Rush
description: Hop on for chaotic fun in Italian Brainrot Bike Rush, a meme-filled obby bike platformer. Pick from 5 absurd meme legends and ride through floating platforms, deadly traps, and wild jumps. Play 5 levels across 3 modes—Normal, Challenge, and One Life. Collect coins, unlock checkpoints, and conquer brainrot chaos. Perfect for fans of meme-based bike racing and Italian brainrot platformers!

title: Kingdom of Pixels
description: Kingdom of Pixels is a 2D multiplayer side-scrolling MOBA and platformer game. It is similar to the style of other MOBAs like League of Legends and DOTA 2.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: PopCats: Merge the cats!
description: An incredibly cute game full of purring and cats. You have to connect identical cats to get bigger and bigger fuzzies. Each of them has its own story! Get to know them and connect the two biggest ones to win! Earn points and become the best cat on the leaderboard!

title: Meow Market
description: In Meow Market, players take on the role of a charming white tabby cat running a bustling vegetable shop. To keep the business thriving, players must harvest fresh veggies by engaging in a click-match puzzle game. Selecting grouped matching vegetables to harvest them efficiently. Each harvest consumes one move, which regenerates over time, encouraging strategic decision-making.
